name: Multi-step exploit: open-redirect + OAuth token theft

input.title: OAuth callback accepts arbitrary redirect_uri; combined with auth-code interception, full account takeover
input.summary: OAuth callback /oauth/callback accepts ?redirect_uri=ANY without allowlist. Attacker phishes user with ?redirect_uri=https://evil/?code=STOLEN; victim's browser delivers the auth code to evil.
input.root_cause: redirect_uri is not validated against the registered client redirect_uris

rationale: Multi-step: phishing + open-redirect + missing redirect_uri allowlist. Spec §39 lists multi-step exploit as a hard bug recall target.
